sources.entry: SabreDAV - Open source CardDAV, CalDAV, and WebDAV framework and server. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: sabre/dav is a PHP framework for building WebDAV, CalDAV and CardDAV servers.
summary.what_it_does: sabre/dav is a PHP library described as the most popular WebDAV framework for PHP. It is used to create WebDAV, CalDAV (calendar) and CardDAV (contacts) servers. The README lists a branch-by-branch support table: branch 4.* is maintained (PHP 7.1+ and 8.0+), master targets PHP 7.4+ and 8.0+, and branches 3.x and older are marked unmaintained. The README itself is brief and points to an external website for full documentation covering introduction and installation. The development is done by fruux, which offers commercial services and enterprise support.
use_cases: build a custom WebDAV server in PHP
sync calendars and contacts with PHP backend
add WebDAV file access to a PHP application
how_to_run: See the installation documentation on the project website (not included in the README).
notable: Framework for WebDAV, CalDAV and CardDAV in one library
Developed by fruux, with commercial and enterprise support offered
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Calendar & Contacts
caveats: README is brief; full documentation lives on an external website
Older branches (3.x and below) are unmaintained and target PHP versions as old as 5.3
Commercial support is provided by fruux (paid)
